parsed.explanation: Direct expansion gives (t-y)^2+4(t+c)(c-b). With this corrected sign, nonnegativity immediately yields the asserted inequality (5), which combines with (6) to prove (7) and hence constancy of d for all points, including fixed points. Thus the objection correctly identifies a sign error, but it is a one-symbol false display: replacing b-c by c-b makes the complete subsequent necessity argument valid.
